subject: Vendor enrollment: AWS/Azure/GCP procurement intake — action items
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Li <morgan.li@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor enrollment: AWS/Azure/GCP procurement intake — action items

Hi Morgan — great to connect earlier. Thank you for outlining CloudBridge's marketplace goals. To move Redwood through your procurement and marketplace enrollment, below are the immediate items we need to make progress this week: 

1) Purchase Order (PO): Please confirm the PO format and whether we should route a vendor invoice to procure@cloudbridge.com or finance@cloudbridge.com. If you prefer, attach your PO template and we will populate it.

2) Vendor intake form: Attached is our vendor intake template (vendor_intake_template.xlsx). Filling it out will speed your marketplace SKU activation across AWS/Azure/GCP.

3) Contract redlines / T&C: If you have standard marketplace T&C or a redline, send to legal@redwood.com — we usually turn commercial redlines in 3 business days for standard clauses.

4) Marketplace listing metadata: Karthik (cc) can capture SKU names, pricing tiers, and technical listing copy once we have the intake form.

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0–2: CloudBridge sends PO template and completed vendor intake form
- Day 3–5: Redwood returns completed PO/invoice and draft listing metadata; legal reviews T&Cs if provided
- Day 6–10: Marketplace activation across selected clouds (subject to partner portal review)

Attachments: redwood_vendor_intake_template.xlsx, redline_sample_contract.pdf

If that timing works, please send the PO template and any vendor ID requirements so Vanessa can kick off the finance routing. Happy to set a 15-min call if you prefer synchronous coordination.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Manager, Marketplaces | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Morgan Li <morgan.li@cloudbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cloudbridge.com, Alex R. <alex.r@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment: AWS/Azure/GCP procurement intake — action items

Ben — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers and one attachment from our side: 

- PO: Attached is CloudBridge's standard PO template (cloudbridge_po_template.pdf). Please populate and return as electronic PDF; routing goes to procure@cloudbridge.com.
- Tax / W-9: We will need Redwood's W-9 (US) and VAT registration (if applicable). Please include with the PO submission.
- Marketplace fees: We have a vendor onboarding fee that is invoiced separately; our partner ops team will confirm whether Redwood qualifies for fee waiver (often applied for platform-native integrations).

Questions for you:
- Does Redwood accept Net-30 by default? We can do Net-45 for first marketplace listing pending procurement review.
- Do you have a singular invoice remit address or separate ones per cloud region?

Attaching CloudBridge PO template. I'll loop in Alex (marketplace ops) to confirm the SKU and listing requirements.

Best,
Morgan Li
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudBridge Inc.
morgan.li@cloudbridge.com

--- Attachment: cloudbridge_po_template.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

Thanks Morgan — appreciate the quick reply and the PO template. Next steps from our side: 

- Vanessa: can you take point on completing the PO and attaching W-9/VAT? Once populated I'll sign and return the PO to procure@cloudbridge.com.
- Karthik: once we have the filled vendor intake form, please start drafting SKU names and the listing copy for AWS/Azure/GCP partner portals. I'm linking a mutual action plan so we can track items: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aZbEXAMPLE-MAP (read-only for now).

Proposed internal handoffs: Vanessa -> Finance submission and invoice setup; Karthik -> Marketplace metadata + portal enrollment; Ben -> Commercial and deal tracking (HubSpot HB-3245).

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx

On Net terms: Redwood standard is Net-30. For this first listing we can accept Net-45 as CloudBridge requested; finance will note that in the invoice.

Ben
Sr. Sales Manager, Marketplaces | Redwood Inference
